label: copy-phase input e (late recall), boosted when e/g/q/0 is being output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input is e (99.6% of activations, 99.8% of mass). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, never for recall_idx <= 2, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Only about 6% of copy-phase e inputs activate. Activation rate rises with later recall position (recall_idx 3-8) and with longer L: L=9 holds 54% of the mass. The token being output also matters a lot: rates are highest when out_tok is g (15x lift), e or q (11x), then 0, b and y. The top activations are e followed by output g. Requiring e input, recall_idx >= 3 and out_tok in {g,e,q,0} gives dev P=0.50, R=0.70, mass recall 0.82. The plain e-input copy-phase predicate has near-full recall but 6% precision. The rest of the gating is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=e (+8.18), in_tok=e (+3.66), next_out=g (+3.37), phase=2 & out_tok=g (+3.14), out_tok=g (+2.91), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+2.74).
